data.one_liner: Fixed decimal numbers with a fixed scale, stored as BigInts, supporting math, formatting and parsing.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Fixed type that stores decimal numbers with a selectable number of decimal places using BigInts for precision. It offers arithmetic operators, comparison, formatting (including locale-aware) and parsing with error handling.
use_when: Need precise decimal arithmetic for currencies or financial data
Require locale-aware formatting and parsing of decimal numbers
Want to avoid floating-point inaccuracies in calculations
avoid_when: Working with arbitrary-precision decimals beyond a fixed scale
Needing binary floating-point math for performance-critical code
strengths: Built-in formatting and parsing with locale support
Full set of arithmetic operators and comparison
Consistent hash codes across different scales
weaknesses: Limited to a fixed number of decimal places
No support for arbitrary-precision beyond the set scale
